raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This is a grouped bar chart displaying the "effect" values for different language families and models. The horizontal axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from 0 to 30 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family has a group of six bars, each representing a different model: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red), as indicated in the legend. Error bars are present above each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The bars are arranged in the same order across all groups, corresponding to the legend. The tallest bars occur in the IE-Indic group, where mBERT-R₂ reaches approximately 20, XLM-R₂ reaches about 18, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ are around 23 and 21, respectively. In contrast, the Uralic group shows very low effect values, mostly near 0, with slight positive values for mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂. The Semitic group shows high variability, particularly for XLM-B₂, which reaches approximately 20 with a large error bar. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard error bars.
